tsc_per_statement_window.finding: instantiationCount resets per top-level statement (checker.go reset sites 2252/2515/7653)
tsc_per_statement_window.proof: 10 tagged QFreezeTag<8,i> statements -> 13,418,995 total instantiations compiled CLEAN in 11.1s
tsc_per_statement_window.cache_note: identical statements share the instantiation cache (4x identical F8 = 2,146,985 ~= single 2,146,925): cached hits return before the counter increments
tsc_per_statement_window.implication: TS2589's 5M ceiling is a per-statement granularity rule, not a compilation budget — arbitrary-scale type-level computation is possible by statement-splitting (subject only to per-statement depth/fuel)
